releases.author: nathanstorm689
releases.description:
## Outlook Event Notes 0.3.0

Create Obsidian notes from Outlook `.msg` files — supports meetings, appointments, and recurring events.

### Highlights
- Recurring event detection with occurrence-date confirmation (closest occurrence to today)
- Opens an existing note instead of creating a duplicate
- Customisable filename pattern and note template (Mustache)
- YAML frontmatter sanitisation
- `.ics` fallback parsing

### Install
Download `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css` into `.obsidian/plugins/outlook-event-notes/`.
